newsitem.title: PERU: Lima stocks end little changed in mixed market.
newsitem.headline: Lima stocks end little changed in mixed market.

text.p: Shares on the Lima Stock Exchange closed little changed Wednesday in moderate trade dominated by local investors, brokers said.
Analysts said major investors remained concerned stocks were overvalued after recent rises and expected little movement in prices in coming sessions.
The General Index edged up 0.05 percent to 1,523.56 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index also gained 0.05 percent to 2,194.68 points.
In a total of 1,025 trades, volume was estimated at a modest 20 million soles ($7.6 million), brokers said.
"It was a very poor session and we don't see things improving until next week at best," said Nernando Pastor of the T&J brokerage.

Among leading stocks, confectionery company D'Onofrio fell 0.87 percent to 1.14 soles on 22,741 shares, while miner Atacocha lost 1.19 percent to 0.83 soles on 545,687 shares. Brewers Backus y Johnston rose 1.39 percent to 2.19 soles on 202,572 shares and benchmark telephone company Telefonica de Peru edged up 0.36 percent to 5.64 soles on 551,887 shares.
